posts.title: Argentina had it rough this world cup
posts.description: yeah, I know, a lot of haters and such. they won the last world cup. still everyone hates them. I love the team, i hate the people watching. this world cup made me want to get rid of my socials. the nasty things people said about argentina and argentinians. the nasty things people called me because i support the team. did i ever disrespect the team you're supporting? gtfo here.

posts.title: I want to cry
posts.description: I haven't slept properly today, and I didn't get to do what I was supposed to this afternoon, so I did myself a disservice and rebooked it for tomorrow early in the morning so I wouldn't be late. I am tired, I am pressured. I'm going to live in the other side of the globe in less than 2 weeks. I'm leaving my parents - as only child I am panicking, I am anxious, I feel guilty, it make me wanna kill

posts.title: Dogs, oh god, dogs
posts.description: It's not their dogs fault that they were born. It's my dad's fault they didn't had them adopted. Now, they're furious at the dogs. Calling them names. But whose fault is it?
